# Third-party notices

This independent TypeScript adaptation is based on the MIT-licensed ideas and implementation of [he-yufeng/RepoWiki](https://github.com/he-yufeng/RepoWiki), reviewed baseline `29d9029b4c770b66772c1d565f2d5b5980074147`. Original copyright: (c) 2026 Yufeng He. The original MIT LICENSE is retained verbatim.

The new TypeScript engine, process/service layers, integration adapters, React workspace and tests are provided under the same MIT terms. Python is not a runtime dependency or subprocess backend. No code from daeisbae/open-repo-wiki was copied.

GrenAnHao/GrenAgent was inspected read-only at `310e57280b58766ad1f67cd5b2ff7e5d61667ee2` to reserve compatible interfaces. Its source is not vendored, modified, or republished. The integration example uses structural interfaces rather than copying its implementation. GrenAgent and Qoder names identify compatibility/references only; this is not an official release of either.

Runtime dependencies include diff (BSD-3-Clause), ignore (MIT), fflate (MIT), React (MIT), react-markdown (MIT), remark-gfm (MIT), DOMPurify (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0), Mermaid (MIT), and frontend dependency transitive packages recorded in package-lock.json files. Compiled bundles retain dependency legal notices. npm installed packages include their own license files. Verify all transitive licenses when redistributing a host application.
